CustomField.description: Percent change in VOIP MRR from the Existing baseline to the resulting book. A renewal re-quotes every line, so Proposed is already the resulting book; every other action type carries only a delta, so Proposed is the change itself. Blank when there is no baseline, which is the zero-division guard.
CustomField.formula: IF( NULLVALUE(Existing_MRR_VOIP__c, 0) = 0, NULL, IF( TEXT(OriginalActionType) = "Renew", (NULLVALUE(Current_MRR_VOIP__c, 0) - NULLVALUE(Existing_MRR_VOIP__c, 0)) / Existing_MRR_VOIP__c, NULLVALUE(Current_MRR_VOIP__c, 0) / Existing_MRR_VOIP__c ) )
CustomField.label: MRR Change % - VOIP
